description: Trace where a URL redirects, hop by hop: each hop's status code (301, 302, 303, 307, 308) and address, up to 10 hops, then where it ends (a page, an error or nothing) — with checks on the chain's length, loops, http:// to https://, permanent versus temporary redirects and a move to another site, each pass / improve / fix with how to fix it. It asks each address once as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), never reads a page's body, and stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: check_redirects

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Trace a URL's redirects
